card.name: Website menu and navigation text
card.fires_on: Words inside web page menus and link bars, such as Professional, Math, our or new in navigation lists. Also some words just before the name Alice in a story.

modes.label: Menu and link bars

modes.description: A word in a site notice or link line, before a page name.

modes.label: Before the name Alice
modes.description: A verb in a story where the next word is the name Alice.

card.writes: It pushes against the name Alice and similar names, and weakly favors some Chinese words.
card.plain: It marks the little words in website menus and link bars, and it holds back the name Alice.
